featured_reviews.name: Balu Nair
featured_reviews.review_text: My car just got a new lease on life thanks to T-serv Bhawani Auto Centre in Powai, Mumbai! They did an absolutely brilliant job renewing and repainting it. The attention to detail is evident, and the finish is just stunning. My car looks as good as new, if not better! Huge shoutout to the professional and efficient team there. If you're in Mumbai and need auto services, especially a repaint, look no further than T-serv Bhawani Auto Centre. Highly, highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Rishikesh Chaughule
featured_reviews.review_text:
What happens when your 14-year-old vehicle meets with an accident? One, spare parts are not easily available. Two, car insurance is not going to be much useful. Besides, you are not sure if the car can be restored to its original self. I had previously got my car suspensions replaced by Bhawani Auto Centre, so this time too, when my car met with an accident, I again chose to go to Bhawani Auto Centre.
Mr. Anto, the owner of the garage, made every possible effort to repair or restore  whatever he could. He went through a lot of troubles to find the original replacement parts, when repairing wasn’t possible. Though the garage does not provide cashless insurance, Mr. Anto personally worked with the insurance assessor to get my claim processed to the extent possible. He gave me a pretty accurate quotation and stayed within that. I also got my car painted from him. And it looked stunning, like a brand new car. His attention to detail is exceptional and he did all that was necessary, all the while keeping me in the loop.
Mr. Anto, just with a few seconds at the wheel, can tell you what is wrong with your vehicle. He has great team of mechanics who can transform your old vehicle into a brand new car, under the watchful eyes of Mr. Anto. I trust this garage because for Mr. Anto has the passion for excellence and also he keeps customer’s interest as a priority.

featured_reviews.name: Ajay Davis
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently had my car serviced here and I am extremely satisfied with the experience. The staff were professional, courteous, and transparent about the entire process. They informed me of all the necessary details beforehand, including the work required and the exact pricing, which gave me complete peace of mind. The service was completed efficiently, and my car is running smoothly. I highly recommend this service centre to anyone looking for reliable and trustworthy car service.

featured_reviews.name: Varun N
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent bumper repair work done at a very reasonable price. Mr. Anto is very helpful and honest. Highly recommend this auto repair shop for trustworthiness, quality of work, and speedy delivery. My family has been using their services for two decades now and it has never disappointed - definitely 5-star worthy

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Raut
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is one of the worst and most dishonest service experiences I have ever had with any app. If you care even a little about your car, stay away from this platform.

Their entire model seems built around sending customers to the cheapest and most unprofessional garages possible. I gave my car only for routine periodic servicing. There were absolutely no issues before service. After getting it back, the car started giving constant problems.

This is the second time I have used this app, and both times have been equally terrible. It is not just my experience. Four of my friends have faced the same situation. The garages they assign do not even meet basic servicing standards. Mechanics appear poorly trained and careless.

The ratings shown on their platform are misleading. When you check the same garages on Google, most of them have terrible ratings, some close to one star. Yet these garages are promoted as trusted partners.

I have spent over 10,000, and instead of getting a properly serviced car, I ended up with a vehicle that has broken down eight times in just ten days. A car that had no issues before servicing is now unreliable because of their incompetence.

This experience feels like a complete rip off. I strongly warn anyone who values their vehicle to avoid this app and go either to a trusted local garage or the official brand service center instead.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Abhishek Raut,

We sincerely apologize for your negative experience and the inconvenience caused. Your feedback is crucial, and we are committed to addressing these issues. Please contact our support team so we can investigate and resolve this matter promptly. We value your trust and aim to improve our service standards significantly.

Write your concern at info@gomechanic.in. Thank you!

featured_reviews.name: Kunjappan Sherin
featured_reviews.review_text: I was doing some checks for car denting and painting via Google and Instagram. Their ad popped up and I happened to send them a message asking for quotation. It was a two days offer of getting a 20% discount for denting and painting. I did go through their page for pictures and found it okay (being honest). I did chat with the guy who responded through Instagram message, he gave me a quotation and ask me to visit the workshop. As soon as I reached the workshop Pawan ji was there to welcome me, he showed me his entire workshop that the kind of work that they carry out. We spoke to for good one and half hour about the work on the car. In simple words I said to Pawanji that I need the work to be good and it should make the car stand out. He agreed and said I might take time to get the work done however the work done on the car will be outstanding to which it did! I appreciate that quite a lot. My car was checked in detail and I was explained what all works will be done. I had been getting daily update about the work done on the car by Pawanji and Zaki (manager). All my requests that needs to be done on the car was taken in to consideration and I was also suggested few things that was good for the car. I took my wife along to show the car while the work was in progress and even my wife was asked for suggestion by Pawanji. I don't think any car workshop guy will go into the depth of car while the work is in process. It's difficult to get a genuine workshop person who understands a car  especially during this pandemic when people are literally getting ripped off by the mechanics. Kudos to Pawanji, Vinayak and Zaki and the entire back end team who helped me get my car back!!!❤️
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Customer! It's always a pleasure to hear from a satisfied customer like you. Delighted to have you as a privileged member of the GoMechanic Family.

Team GoMechanic
